name: Hinojales (Spain)
description: White field with stripes of yellow and blue along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Hinojales (a castle on yellow above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Hinojales; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Hinojales arms — castle on yellow above waves
cap of the crown of the arms
